title: Strong freezing in binary perceptron models
summary: The binary perceptron model concerns the set of solutions obtained by intersecting random half-spaces. One of the most striking physics predictions for this model, going back to Krauth and Mézard [KM89] and sharpened in [HWK13, HK14], is strong freezing: typical solutions are at Hamming distance of order $n$ from every other solution. This phenomenon has attracted a lot of attention over the years, partly because of its intricate connections to statistical physics and computational complexity. We prove strong freezing at every positive constraint density for a general class of perceptron…
